memo.headline: Riverbend is a strong local food-insecurity fit, but ask about outcome measurement and current financial reporting before giving.
memo.summary: Riverbend Community Pantry is a fictional DEMO charity and a strong overall fit for your interest in food insecurity in New Haven. Its filings show a surplus and a net-asset reserve proxy, while contributions and grants make up most reported revenue. The site reports households served and food distributed, but those figures are self-reported, unverified, and the charity says it has not measured changes in household food security. Transparency is a weaker area: the latest financial data in the record are for 2024, and the site does not link a financial report.
memo.recommendation: Before giving, ask whether a more recent filing or audited statements are available, and what share of expenses went to program services. Ask how the charity plans to measure changes in household food security and how it manages reliance on contributions and grants. If its answers give you confidence in its reporting and outcome plans, it appears reasonable to consider a gift.

memo.method_note: Financial figures come from the newest Form 990 filing with extracted data in ProPublica's free Nonprofit Explorer API, which can be a year or more behind the newest PDF filing, and from deterministic calculations; the AI agents interpret these figures but do not produce them. Web pages were sanitized before any model read them (hidden text and instructions aimed at AI removed), and a deterministic verifier removed findings whose numbers did not match the evidence ledger. Program-spending share is not in that extract, so it is listed as a question for each charity. Scores use a documented rubric (docs/scoring-rubric.md); its thresholds are hypotheses, not facts.

CALC-000000001-net_assets_months.label: Reserves proxy (net assets in months of expenses)
CALC-000000001-net_assets_months.excerpt: Net assets divided by monthly expenses (total expenses / 12) for the latest year. This is a reserves proxy: net assets can include buildings and restricted funds that cannot pay for operations. FY2024: net assets $651,000 divided by monthly expenses ($1,531,800 / 12 = $127,650) = 5.1 months.

CALC-000000001-liabilities_to_assets.label: Liabilities to assets
CALC-000000001-liabilities_to_assets.excerpt: Total liabilities divided by total assets for the latest year. FY2024: total liabilities (end of year) $96,400, divided by total assets (end of year) $747,400 = 12.9%.

CALC-000000001-revenue_cagr_3y.label: Revenue growth per year (about 3 years)
CALC-000000001-revenue_cagr_3y.excerpt: Compound annual growth of total revenue since the filing about 3 years before the latest one: (latest / earlier) to the power 1/years, minus 1. Total revenue went from $1,212,400 in FY2021 to $1,583,900 in FY2024 over 3 years: ($1,583,900 / $1,212,400) to the power 1/3, minus 1 = 9.3% per year.

CALC-000000001-expense_cagr_3y.label: Expense growth per year (about 3 years)
CALC-000000001-expense_cagr_3y.excerpt: Compound annual growth of total expenses since the filing about 3 years before the latest one: (latest / earlier) to the power 1/years, minus 1. Total expenses went from $1,154,300 in FY2021 to $1,531,800 in FY2024 over 3 years: ($1,531,800 / $1,154,300) to the power 1/3, minus 1 = 9.9% per year.

CALC-000000001-revenue_volatility_cv.label: Revenue volatility (coefficient of variation, up to 5 years)
CALC-000000001-revenue_volatility_cv.excerpt: Sample standard deviation of total revenue divided by its mean, over up to the 5 newest filings (needs at least 3). Total revenue for FY2021 to FY2024 (4 filings): standard deviation $160,725 divided by mean $1,390,588 = 11.6%.

CALC-000000001-contributions_share.label: Contributions and grants as a share of revenue
CALC-000000001-contributions_share.excerpt: Contributions and grants divided by total revenue for the latest year. FY2024: contributions and grants $1,476,350, divided by total revenue $1,583,900 = 93.2%.

CALC-000000001-revenue_concentration_hhi.label: Revenue concentration index (HHI across 4 sources)
CALC-000000001-revenue_concentration_hhi.excerpt: Sum of squared shares of four revenue sources (contributions, program service revenue, investment income, other) for the latest year. Negative sources count as 0. 1.0 means a single source. FY2024 shares: contributions 93.2%, program service revenue 3.7%, investment income 0.9%, other revenue 2.2%. Sum of squared shares = 0.871.

CALC-000000001-officer_comp_share.label: Officer compensation as a share of expenses
CALC-000000001-officer_comp_share.excerpt: Compensation of current officers and key employees divided by total expenses, latest year. FY2024: compensation of current officers and key employees $103,000, divided by total expenses $1,531,800 = 6.7%.

CALC-000000001-staff_cost_share.label: Staff costs as a share of expenses (officers, salaries, payroll tax)
CALC-000000001-staff_cost_share.excerpt: Officer compensation plus other salaries and wages plus payroll taxes, divided by total expenses, latest year. FY2024: compensation of current officers and key employees $103,000 + other salaries and wages $368,900 + payroll taxes $36,100 = $508,000 in staff costs, divided by total expenses $1,531,800 = 33.2%.

CALC-000000001-pro_fundraising_fee_share.label: Professional fundraising fees as a share of contributions
CALC-000000001-pro_fundraising_fee_share.excerpt: Professional fundraising fees divided by contributions and grants, latest year. FY2024: professional fundraising fees $12,400, divided by contributions and grants $1,476,350 = 0.8%.

CALC-000000001-filing_recency_years.label: Years since the latest filing with data
CALC-000000001-filing_recency_years.excerpt: Current calendar year minus the tax year of the latest filing with data. 2026 minus FY2024 = 2.

CALC-000000001-years_of_filings.label: Years of filings with data
CALC-000000001-years_of_filings.excerpt: Number of tax years with Form 990 data in the ProPublica extract. Tax years with data: 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021 (4).

CALC-000000001-program_expense_share.label: Program expense share
CALC-000000001-program_expense_share.excerpt: Program service expenses divided by total expenses. Not computed: Not in the free IRS extract (Form 990 Part IX, column B). Ask the charity or read the filing PDF.
